_note: Edit the 'targets' list freely. Every id was checked against the SatNOGS DB on 2026-10-01 and was 'in orbit' at that time. You do not need to put credentials in this file: the Orbital Ops menu asks for the Space-Track password and the N2YO key once, hidden, and can remember them in your own user folder if you say yes. Or put them in hannibal_credentials.local.json, or set the SPACETRACK_USER / SPACETRACK_PASS / N2YO_API_KEY environment variables. Never put real credentials in this file: it is bundled into the .exe.
